brief.question: Build a desktop painting colour assistant: open an image, crop it, view a greyscale value study with N levels, a colour-reduced version with N levels, overlay a composition grid (rule of thirds, Fibonacci spiral, square grid), and for each reduced colour compute a Kubelka-Munk mixing recipe from a user-defined pigment palette (watercolor / acrylic / oil, with transparency per paint).
brief.purpose: Tool for an artist planning a painting; no original program to match, built from the request alone.
brief.done_when: cargo build succeeds, screenshot shows the workspace with a sample image, self-test passes move/act/hud, palettes can be created and saved, recipes shown per colour.

handoff: Glazing turn (2026-11-24), all verified, NOT committed. Person asked "implement glazing method (layering transparent paints)". km::Method {Mix default, Glaze}; Mixer::with_method; App::method + App::recipe_mixer(); PictureSettings.method #[serde(default)]. Physics: film_rt (KM R,T of a free film) + over (R + T^2 Rg/(1-R Rg)). Films are precomputed for non-opaque, non-white paints at GLAZE_LOADS [1,.55,.3,.16,.075,.035] x Mixer::glaze_full[paint]: watercolor 1.0 (the full wash); acrylic/oil per paint = thinnest film with T^2 <= FULL_GLAZE_T2 (0.02) in its most absorbed band or within FULL_GLAZE_DE (2) of the masstone over the white ground (max 64). A single global thickness was tried first and rejected: a "veil" of black was nearly black. find_glaze: exhaustive first layer (watercolor: one paint x water loads; body: white ground or one paint x white parts) x up to 2 glazes of different paints, score dE + 0.8 per extra paint, 1-6 ms per colour. Recipe.glazes; Mixer::stages; wording "A, then B, then C" / "like tea / like milk" / "1 paint + 3 white; glazes: thin / a veil". UI: Method segmented (method_0/1, tooltip method_tip, hud "method"); count label "Layers", checkbox "Lighten first layer" in Glaze; layer chips (recipe_layers_i); "no transparent paints" hint. PDF: Method/Layers rows, "Glazing recipes" page. CLI: --glaze, --medium <watercolor|acrylic|oil>. Tests: 23 unit tests, self-test 30/30 (method_tooltip, glaze, glaze_off, export_pdf_glaze, glaze_acrylic). Both builds warning-free. Docs: MECHANICS.md Glazing section, mechanics.json (104 values), README, CHANGELOG, CLAUDE.md (outside app/). Open: unk_b8c7 (glaze thickness estimated; first layer is one paint), unk_d84d, unk_922d.
